items.notes: Take Training Session 1 first. The trainer reads the surprises from these notes. Do not tell the trainee which one is coming.
Press Space when the video ends.
Go through each move once with the trainee before the rehearsal.

header.title: Rehearsal service. The trainer calls the surprises

items.notes: Run the rehearsal twice: slowly, then at the speed of a real service. Press Reset training in Plan between runs.

text.title: Welcome
text.body:
Welcome!
We are glad you are here.

items.notes: SURPRISE 5 (blank in an emergency) can come at any moment from here on. Trainer: say "Blank!". Operator: full stop. Full stop again when the trainer says "Back". SURPRISE 2 (order change). Trainer, while this is on air: "We are singing Amazing Grace first."
SURPRISE 2 (order change). The cue came during Welcome. Operator: Shift+Down to Amazing Grace, Enter. When it ends, Shift+Up to Holy, Holy, Holy and Enter.
SURPRISE 1 (repeated verse). Trainer, during the last verse: "Again! Verse one!" Operator: press 1. (In a song with a chorus, C jumps to it.)

SURPRISE 3 (scripture on the fly). Trainer, during this reading: "Turn with me to Romans 8:28." Operator: press /, type Rom 8:28, then Shift+Enter puts it on air now. It is added to this practice service only; Reset training takes it out again. SURPRISE 4 (updated deck). Trainer, before the reading ends: "The preacher changed the verse slide this morning. Use the new deck."
SURPRISE 4 (updated deck). The cue came during the reading. The trainee should skip this deck and use the next one.
The corrected deck. Space through the builds.
Needs a phone on the same Wi-Fi as this computer. Do this after the rehearsal, before the debrief.
Press Space when the video ends. If it says the video isn't ready yet, go straight to the slides.
Two kinds of phone, and how to connect one. Space through the builds.

text.title: Practice: a speaker's phone
text.body:
Connect your phone as a speaker
for the sermon, then step through it.

items.notes: Trainee: Present › More › Connect a phone or tablet. Choose Speaker, and for whose slides choose "Sermon (updated Sunday morning)". Scan the code with your phone and type the PIN. The phone says "Waiting for your slides". Trainer: Shift+Up to the sermon and Enter. Trainee: press Next on the phone through the builds; on the last slide Next does nothing. Trainer: More › Clear all; the phone says the service team has cleared the screen. Then show the sermon again. Finally, Setup › Devices › Revoke the phone. If there is time, connect it again as Run the service and press Next from the phone.
Stop the rehearsal here and talk it through.
Ask the three questions on the first slide. If any answer is yes, press Reset training in Plan and run the rehearsal again.
